Primary contact: Nora Ruiz (CEO). CTO: Ben Lowe (developer lead).

Current traffic profile provided: 50–200 chat requests/day, bursts during support hours; average exchange length ~220 tokens per user turn; many repeat queries on FAQs.

POC acceptance criteria proposed by customer: (1) 30%+ cost reduction vs current naive calls; (2) median latency < 400ms for first token on hosted API; (3) no increase in user-reported incorrect answers above current baseline.

Quotes: Nora — 'We want the fastest path to make our support bot economical. If Redwood can show easy changes that save us money, we convert this month.'
Risks: may opt for competitor credits if savings numbers unclear; technical team is small — wants minimal integration changes.

Suggested quick wins: enable streaming to trim output tokens, apply prompt compression templates, switch to embeddings-only routing for FAQ matches (short-circuit full chat), set a soft per-request max tokens limit.
